jobs.title: Electrical Cabling Engineer (BE-EA-EC-2026-237-GRAE)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

As an Electrical Engineer, within the Beams Department, you will join the BE-EA-EC cabling team to work on projects for the LHC and CERN's experiments. We aim to optimise and maintain the infrastructure and provide strong support to the physicists. You will support the team with the study, execution and coordination of complex technical cabling projects.

**Your responsibilities:**

* Support the gathering of user requirements and provide technical assistance.
* Contribute to technical studies, cost estimates, and project documentation.
* Assist with the procurement of materials and services.
* Participate in the assembly, installation, and testing of cabling and electrical equipment.
* Support workshop and on-site activities related to experiment infrastructure.
* Assist with prototype development, commissioning, and reception tests.
* Contribute to project coordination activities and technical meetings.
* Support the preparation and review of technical reports, specifications, and change requests.
* Apply and promote quality assurance procedures and documentation standards.
* Continuously develop technical expertise and contribute to team knowledge sharing.

More information here.

**Your profile:**

* Initial experience in the electrical domain.
* Experience working with industry standards and Electrical Safety Systems.
* Previous use of related electrical software packages would be an asset.

Skills:

* Excellent team-working attitude.
* Ability to manage several activities simultaneously and meet tight deadlines.
* Good perception of colors.
* Good writing skills in English for technical documentation.
* Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.

Eligibility criteria:

* You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
* **By the application deadline,** you have a **maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation** in Electrical Engineering (or a related field) **and** **your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree**.
* You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
* Applicants without University degree are not eligible.
* Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

  
**Additional Information**

Job closing date: **27.10.2026 at CET.**

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.

Working hours: 40 hours per week

Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

Target start date: 01-February-2027

This position involves:

* Work in Radiation Areas.
* Interventions in underground installations.

Job reference: BE-EA-EC-2026-237-GRAE

Field of work: Electrical Engineering

Benchmark job: 200030 - Electrical Engineer

**Global Benefits**

* A monthly net stipend of either 5266 or 5793 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
* 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
* Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
* Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
* A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
* Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
* On-the-job and formal training including language classes.

**Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!**

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.

Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.

If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! **TAKE PART!**

**More information about us, here:** **careers.cern**

jobs.title: Full-Stack Web Engineer (IT-PW-WDA-2026-108-GRAE)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for a full-stack software developer with DevOps experience. In this role, you will be a member of the Web, DevOps and Authoring section in the IT-PW group.

We have been consolidating all Web hosting services on our Platform as a Service (PaaS) infrastructure based on OpenShift/OKD4, including the supported CERN Web Content Management Systems (Drupal, WordPress). By joining us, you will support and contribute to the continuous improvement of .CERN top-level domain management and hosting.

CERN is managing its own top level internet domain. This generic top-level domain (gTLD) is used for hosting highly visible public websites such as CERN, Careers, openlab, etc.

**Your responsibilities:**

* Supporting and further integration of the handling of the top-level domain .CERN, including the process of certificate procurement and automation of certificate renewal.
* Implementation of features for the CERN Web infrastructure services, including the Web Services Portal and dedicated functionality such as information retrieval from .CERN sites and extensions to the hosting mechanisms used for .CERN sites.

**Your profile:**

* Experience with full-stack software development.
* Experience with version control systems and CI/CD workflows.
* Experience with container orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes / OpenShift is a plus.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a proactive mindset to identify challenges and drive innovative solutions.
* Good communication and collaboration skills, with ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.
* Strong commitment to user satisfaction, actively seeking feedback and collaborating with users to continuously improve services.

Skills:

* Programming in Python, JavaScript, React.
* Knowledge of Web protocols and technologies (including certificates).
* Git, CI/CD tools, test and deployment automation.
* Knowledge of Web Content Management Systems would be an asset.
* Linux and Bash scripting.
* Experience with Kubernetes and/or OpenShift/OKD container technology is a plus.
* Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility criteria:

* You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
* **By the application deadline,** you have a **maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation** in Software or computer engineering (or a related field) **and** **your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree**.
* You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
* Applicants without University degree are not eligible.
* Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

  
**Additional Information**

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.

Working hours: 40 hours per week

Job flexibility: Hybrid

Target start date: 01-June-2026

Job reference: IT-PW-WDA-2026-108-GRAE

Field of work: Software Engineering and IT

Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer

**Global Benefits**

* A monthly net stipend of either 5266 or 5793 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
* 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
* Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
* Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
* A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
* Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
* On-the-job and formal training including language classes.

**Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!**

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.

Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. jobs.title: C# / .NET szoftverfejlesztő állás
jobs.description:
**Kövess minket!**

**Jelentkezem az álláshirdetésre**

Azonosító: 14396 Helyszín: Budapest XIII. Feladat: Full stack fejlesztés

Partnerünk 1989 óta a hazai piac meghatározó szereplője, a bér- és HR-szoftverek területén piacvezető és trendteremtő vállalat. Megoldásaikkal minden negyedik hazai munkavállaló találkozik a bérpapírján vagy mobilalkalmazásukon keresztül. Termékeik sikere a Kutatás és Fejlesztés csapat munkájának köszönhető, ahol a jövő HR-digitalizációs megoldásait tervezik és hozzák létre.
  
Csatlakozz a csapatukhoz, és légy részese a hazai sikermegoldások nemzetközi piacra történő felkészítésének! Egy olyan ösztönző környezet vár, ahol az innovatív szakmai tudás a korszerű webes és backend technológiákkal találkozik.

**Feladatok**
-------------

* Részvétel az üzleti és fejlesztői betanulási folyamatban, amely megalapozza a termékek és technológiák mély megismerését
* Agilis módszertan mentén, 2-4 fős dedikált fejlesztői csapatokban való hatékony együttműködés
* Kliensoldali és backend funkciók tervezése, implementálása és refaktorálása
* Megbízható, tiszta kód írása és az üzleti logika lefedése automata tesztekkel
* Meglévő és új generációs modulok integrációja, architektúrális fejlesztése
* Részvétel a hazai piacon már bizonyított bérügyviteli megoldások nemzetközi piacra vitelében

**Elvárások**
-------------

* Legalább 5-10 év releváns szoftverfejlesztői tapasztalat
* Magabiztos C# és .NET háttér (ASP.NET MVC, Web API)
* Kliensoldali / frontend webes tapasztalat (Angular)
* Relációs adatbázisok és ORM rendszerek mély ismerete (pl. NHibernate, Entity Framework)
* IoC / DI containerek készségszintű használata (pl. Autofac vagy beépített .NET DI)
* Automata tesztelési rutin és igényesség a kódminőség iránt (Unit / Integration testing)
* RESTful API-k és szervizarchitektúrák tervezésében, fejlesztésében szerzett gyakorlat
* Eredményorientált, minőségtudatos hozzáállás

**Előnyök**
-----------

* Tapasztalat az alábbi technológiák valamelyikében: Angular 1.x, WebApi, OData, Autofac, NHibernate, SignalR, FluentValidation, EPPlus
* Más modern webes keretrendszerben (modern Angular, React) vagy korszerű .NET Core / .NET 8 környezetben szerzett tapasztalat
* Nagyvállalati üzleti, bérügyviteli vagy ERP rendszerek fejlesztésében szerzett jártasság
* Angol nyelvtudás (nemzetközi projektek és piacra lépés támogatásához)
* Strukturált, tiszta architektúrális szemlélet (Clean Architecture, DDD, mikroszervizek)

**Amit ajánlunk**
-----------------

* Naprakész bérpiaci információkra alapozott versenyképes bér, az átlagnál magasabb cafeteria keret, teljesítménybónusz
* Valódi munka-magánélet egyensúly: rugalmas munkaidő, heti több napos otthoni munkavégzés (hibrid modell)
* Munkába járás támogatása: bérlettámogatás, zárt kerékpártároló, öltöző és zuhanyzó
* Családbarát intézkedések: nyári gyerektáboroztatás támogatása, családi rendezvények, munkatársi segélyezési rendszer
* Prémium munkakörnyezet: „A´ kategóriás, díjnyertes irodaház a Váci úton, tágas személyes terekkel és zöld erkélyekkel
* Feltöltődési lehetőségek az irodában: pihenőszoba, jól felszerelt saját tornaterem, reggeli közös jógaóra, teraszos programok és összetartó közösség
